policy.purpose: Configure a deliberately small set of constraint-aware troubleshooters on top of existing canonical Brali problem pages.
policy.growth_rule: Prove one useful end-to-end flow before adding more. Do not create a new indexable URL for each answer combination or personalized result.
policy.selection_rule: Ask only constraints that can change protocol eligibility. Select only trusted gold-ready candidates; otherwise abstain rather than weakening the trust boundary.
policy.interpretation_rule: A selected protocol is a transparent bounded trial under represented constraints, not a psychological fit score or a claim that the method will work.

troubleshooters.title: Should you protect a focus block — or not?
troubleshooters.summary: Two constraints decide whether Brali's current trusted focus-boundary protocol is a sensible trial after interruptions. This check does not diagnose why you were interrupted.
troubleshooters.abstention_message: Brali does not currently have a trusted focus-block recommendation for these conditions. Use the re-entry decision path on this page, change the work conditions if you can, or inspect other trusted protocols instead of forcing a timer.
